name: Beed

queries.query: Beed Maharashtra official GIS map cadastral parcel property map
queries.result: Official results identified the District Beed land-records page, Maharashtra MahaBhumi/BhuNaksha services, the Beed district land-records custodian page, and national DILRMP map-digitization status for Beed. No indexed public parcel ID-plus-geometry response was exposed.

queries.query: बीड महाराष्ट्र अधिकृत GIS नकाशा मालमत्ता भूखंड कॅडस्ट्रल
queries.result: Official Marathi results identified the Beed District Superintendent of Land Records page, its subordinate Beed land-records office, duties to preserve cadastral/village/city-survey maps and provide copies, and Maharashtra e-map/BhuNaksha services. No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was exposed.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Marathi first-party discovery, followed by TLS-verified bounded access to the official BhuNaksha viewer. No credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe-field request, or TLS disablement.

portalsFound.observation: Official Beed District Superintendent of Land Records page names the district custodian and subordinate Beed office, and describes preservation/provision of village and city-survey maps, property cards and land-record copies. This establishes local registry/cadastral custody, not an open parcel API.
Official District Beed land-records page links eFerfar and digitally signed 7/12 services and identifies the district administration as content owner. It does not expose parcel geometry.
Official Maharashtra land-records portal lists MahaBhumi services including Mahabhunakasha (maps with land records) and MH DIGI Maps.

Official Maharashtra BhuNaksha viewer route was identified as the parcel-map candidate; direct anonymous retrieval timed out before HTML/JavaScript/configuration or a public feature request could be inspected.
Official Government of India DILRMP page reports map-digitization/georeferencing status headings for Beed district. It is status metadata, not a parcel feature service.

requests.assessment: TLS-verified bounded request timed out after 25 seconds. No inference about citywide cadastral absence was made; no response body, schema, CRS, native ID or geometry was retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Beed city/local land-records custody under the District Superintendent of Land Records, Maharashtra state MahaBhumi/BhuNaksha services, and national DILRMP status metadata.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local custodial and procedure evidence plus identification of the official parcel-map viewer; no open parcel geometry response was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The current BhuNaksha viewer/API route, access controls, layer schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity, update currency, legal access conditions and citywide coverage remain unresolved. The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and never shifted; no exact-point hit or miss was inferred. No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
nextStep: A later attempt may inspect the official BhuNaksha viewer through an available public route and issue only a bounded anonymous safe-ID-plus-geometry request if the service reveals one.
